arguments.title: ContextForge decision — customers
arguments.content:
# ContextForge approved change decision

## Request
Deprecate customers.legacy_segment and migrate downstream analytics to customer_tier.

## Target
`urn:li:dataset:(urn:li:dataPlatform:snowflake,commerce.public.customers,PROD)`

## DataHub evidence used
- Owner: data-platform
- Governance: PII, Tier1
- Downstream assets: stg_customers, dim_customers, marketing_audience
- Observed query patterns: 2

## Decision
The compatibility migration was reviewed and explicitly approved for pull-request readiness. ContextForge did not auto-merge or execute the data change.

## Context memory
Persist this Decision so later DataHub-connected agents can inherit the rationale.

note: Example payload only. A live write requires explicit --approve --write-back and configured DataHub credentials/permissions.
